description: Foundation: the browser Supabase client, real Supabase-Auth session wiring in AuthContext, route guards + the /admin route in App.jsx, Header role/nav fixes, the Signup/Login auth calls, and the env/config templates. This is the base every later feature depends on. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 only in that it comes first; they build on it.
steps: Create src/lib/supabase.js: export a singleton `supabase` from createClient(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL, import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) using the PUBLISHABLE/anon key (NEVER service-role). If either var is missing, throw a clear Error at client-init (module evaluation / first access) — a RUNTIME error, NOT a build failure. Keep default session persistence (localStorage).

Create .env.example at the worktree ROOT (tracked, placeholders only): lines VITE_SUPABASE_URL=, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=, VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api, plus comments that real values go in .env.local (git-ignored) and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is the public anon key (RLS protects data; service-role key must never appear here).

Edit the root .gitignore: add a root-level `!.env.example` negation on its own line placed AFTER the existing `.env.*` ignore line (negations only take effect after the pattern that would ignore them). Leave the existing `!supabase/scripts/.env.example` negation untouched.

Rewrite src/context/AuthContext.jsx to wrap Supabase Auth. Remove DEMO_MODE/DEMO_STUDENT/readUser localStorage shim. On mount call supabase.auth.getSession(); subscribe to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange (unsubscribe on unmount). Expose a `loading` flag true until the first session resolves. When a session exists, fetch the profiles row (select id, role, full_name, email, mobile, avatar_url where id = uid) and set user = { id, email, role, full_name, mobile, avatar_url } (role lowercase). On sign-out set user = null.

In AuthContext, implement: login({email,password}) -> supabase.auth.signInWithPassword; logout() -> supabase.auth.signOut; signup({name,email,phone,password,role,store}) -> supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { full_name: name, role, mobile: phone, store_name: role==='vendor' ? store : null } } }) (DO NOT send store_slug); updateUser(patch) -> supabase.from('profiles').update(<mapped snake_case columns: name->full_name, avatar->avatar_url, mobile->mobile>).eq('id', user.id) then refresh local user; changePassword({next}) -> supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: next }); deleteAccount keeps throwing new Error('Account deletion is not available yet.'). Add `loading` and `signup` to the context value; keep useAuth()/AuthProvider contract.

Add guards + the admin route in src/App.jsx (inline, or a small src/components/RouteGuards.jsx): RequireAuth renders children if useAuth().user else <Navigate to='/login' replace/>; RequireRole({role,children}) renders children if user?.role===role else redirect (unauthenticated->/login, wrong role->/). While useAuth().loading is true, render a lightweight centered splash (e.g. 'Loading…') to avoid redirect flicker. Gate: /profile->RequireRole student, /dashboard->RequireRole vendor, /admin (NEW)->RequireRole admin rendering Admin, /cart and /order/:id->RequireAuth; /, /search, /vendor/:id, /login, /signup, * stay public. Import src/pages/Admin.jsx; since the full Admin page is built in FEAT-004, create a minimal placeholder src/pages/Admin.jsx now (a simple component returning a 'Admin console' heading) so the import compiles — FEAT-004 replaces it.

Update src/components/Header.jsx: profilePath becomes role==='admin' ? '/admin' : role==='vendor' ? '/dashboard' : '/profile' (lowercase). Make the hard-coded 'Vendor Dashboard' NavLink role-conditional: 'Vendor Dashboard'->/dashboard for vendors, 'Admin'->/admin for admins, hidden for students/anonymous. Remove the always-visible 'frontend preview only' /profile NavLink in the logged-out branch. Replace user?.name with user?.full_name and user.avatar with user.avatar_url for the chip/avatar.

Wire src/pages/Login.jsx submit to useAuth().login({ email, password }) (await; navigate('/') on success; surface an error message on failure) — remove the fake name-from-email login. Leave the Facebook button as a deferred stub.

Wire src/pages/Signup.jsx goNext/submit to useAuth().signup({ name: form.name, email: form.email, phone: form.phone, password: form.password, role, store: form.store }) (await; on success navigate role==='vendor' ? '/dashboard' : '/'; surface errors). Keep the student/vendor-only role switch unchanged (no admin option). Leave the Facebook button a deferred stub.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/supabase.js exports a Supabase client built from VITE_ env vars and throws a clear runtime error (not a build error) when they are missing.
.env.example exists at the worktree root with the three VITE_ placeholder keys and is TRACKABLE by git (not ignored); no .env.local is created and no keys are hardcoded.

AuthContext no longer contains DEMO_MODE/PREVIEW_USER/readUser; it hydrates from supabase.auth.getSession(), subscribes to onAuthStateChange, exposes {user,loading,login,logout,signup,updateUser,changePassword,deleteAccount}, and user is {id,email,role,full_name,mobile,avatar_url} with lowercase role.
App.jsx exposes RequireAuth/RequireRole with a loading splash, gates /profile (student), /dashboard (vendor), /admin (admin), /cart and /order/:id (auth), and imports an Admin page.
Header shows the correct profile/dashboard/admin link per lowercase role and no longer shows the preview-only /profile link.
Login and Signup call the real Supabase auth functions with the exact signUp options.data keys full_name/role/mobile/store_name (no store_slug).
`npm run build` succeeds in the worktree.
verification: git check-ignore .env.example  (returns non-zero: the file is NOT ignored)
findings:
DONE. Build green (120 modules, exit 0). git check-ignore .env.example => exit 1 (tracked). No DEMO_MODE/PREVIEW_USER/readUser in worktree AuthContext. No capitalized role-comparison literals in Header (the only 'Student' left is an aria-label display fallback, harmless).

=== For later features ===
supabase client import: `import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase'` (singleton, default localStorage session persistence; throws at module-eval if VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY missing — RUNTIME only, build stays green). Path from src/pages or src/components is '../lib/supabase'; from src/context it's '../lib/supabase'.

useAuth() context value shape (from src/context/AuthContext.jsx): { user, loading, login, logout, signup, updateUser, changePassword, deleteAccount }.
  - user is null when signed out, else { id, email, role, full_name, mobile, avatar_url }. role is LOWERCASE ('student'|'vendor'|'admin'); may be '' if the profiles row is missing. full_name/mobile/avatar_url default to '' not null.
  - loading: true until the first getSession() resolves; also set by onAuthStateChange.
  - login({email,password}) async -> throws Error on failure.
  - logout() async -> signs out, sets user null.
  - signup({name,email,phone,password,role,store}) async -> supabase.auth.signUp with options.data keys full_name/role/mobile/store_name (store_name only for role==='vendor', else null). NO store_slug sent.
  - updateUser(patch) async -> maps name->full_name, avatar->avatar_url, mobile->mobile (also accepts full_name/avatar_url directly), updates profiles where id=user.id, then refetches and updates local user.
  - changePassword({next}) async -> supabase.auth.updateUser({password:next}).
  - deleteAccount() -> still throws Error('Account deletion is not available yet.').

Guards live INLINE in src/App.jsx (not a separate RouteGuards file): RequireAuth and RequireRole({role, children}). Both render a centered 'Loading…' splash (AuthSplash) while loading. RequireAuth: no user -> Navigate /login replace. RequireRole: no user -> /login, wrong role -> /. Routes gated: /profile=RequireRole student, /dashboard=RequireRole vendor, /admin=RequireRole admin (renders Admin), /cart & /order/:id=RequireAuth. Public: /, /search, /vendor/:id, /login, /signup, *.

src/pages/Admin.jsx is a MINIMAL placeholder ('Admin console' heading) — FEAT-004 must replace it (and add Admin.css).

.env.example at worktree root has VITE_SUPABASE_URL=, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=, VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api. .gitignore got `!.env.example` added right after `.env.*`. Note: `*.local` in .gitignore means .env.local is ignored both via that and .env.* — do not create it with real values.

Header: profilePath = admin->/admin, vendor->/dashboard, else /profile; nav shows 'Vendor Dashboard' for vendors, 'Admin' for admins, neither for students/anon; chip uses user.full_name + user.avatar_url.
